name: What are key considerations when choosing a contractor for accessibility modifications?

mainEntity.name: What are key considerations when choosing a contractor for accessibility modifications?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for bedroom accessibility modifications, prioritize experience with similar projects and a strong understanding of accessibility standards. Look for contractors who are licensed and insured, can provide references from previous clients, and offer clear, detailed proposals. Communication style, their ability to collaborate with occupational therapists or other specialists, and their commitment to a transparent process are also crucial. A good contractor will listen to your specific needs and offer thoughtful, practical solutions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, experienced contractor with references who understands accessibility standards, communicates clearly, and provides detailed proposals.
